ns2:section.sectionText: Registration restricted to College of Business students and Actuarial Science majors. Remaining seats will open to Business Minor students having completed ACCY 200 here at Illinois will be able to register for F221 at approximately noon November 24th. Prerequisites are enforced - students without the prerequisites will be dropped from the course.
